STP.winter_28: As we stand on the brink of a new year, I can't help but reflect how each passing day with you has made my heart swell with love and gratitude.$h#$b#Here's to another year of us, my love.[348]$h
STP.RWE.married_Elliott: While I was setting up my things in our room earlier, I couldn't help but notice that you safely tucked all of the letters I sent you on our nightstand.$h#$b#I'm moved beyond words, @. Knowing you’ve kept them so close… means everything to me.#$e#I love you, @.
STP.RWE.spouseRoom_Elliott_0: Hi darling, apologies for the mess in my office the other day. I just spent nearly an hour organizing my desk before you woke up.#$b#I know you understand but I've also made sure to keep my working space neater. You already take on so much work, and the last thing I want is to make it harder on you, love.$h
STP.RWE.spouseRoom_Elliott_1: You know, lived experiences are often fragmented, localized, and even subjective.$7#$b#When I attempt to write about things I have not personally lived through, I make it a point to do my research and widen my perspectives.#$e#After all, I believe this is our ethical responsibility as writers. Either this or not writing at all.$7
STP.RWE.spouseRoom_Elliott_2: @, do you think Gunther has a manual I can borrow on decoding modern slangs? Or should I go ask the younger adults in town?$2#$b#I saw someone from an online forum call one of my colleagues a 'GOAT' today... I'm not sure how being compared to livestock is flattering.$h
STP.RWE.spouseRoom_Elliott_3: While you were out, my agent called to inform me about this thing called 'fanfiction' made by one of my readers.#$e#Will I read it, you ask?#$b#Frankly, I'm quite flattered but I can't find myself to open this... link my agent sent me.$2#$b#Better wary of those spam mails, dear.
STP.RWE.spouseRoom_Elliott_4: You know, I used to believe that I did not need an agent, that I could handle all of the workload by myself.#$b#Looking back now, I chuckle remembering how sorely mistaken I was. I never realized how much I'd actually lean on my agent's guidance in understanding how this industry works.$h
STP.RWE.Good_9: Oh, did you find the sticky note I left on your pillow this morning?$h#$$b#I might... have gone a little overboard with the hearts.$e#The occasion?#$b#Oh darling, I just wanted to let you know that you're my reason to keep striving forward. That's all.
STP.RWE.Indoor_Day_8: My love!$h#$b#Imagine my delight when I heard that one of my favorite authors', P. Child, latest novel hit the shelves yesterday!#$e#Sadly, I can't seem... to figure out how to order online.$2#$e#It's quite humbling, really.$2
STP.RWE.Outdoor_8: Gunther often keeps me posted about new books coming in the library. I think I've developed some type of friendship with him, at the very least.$h#$e#Hmm, today might be a good day to visit the library. I might even pick up a book or two..
STP.RWE.eventSeen_3912132_memory_oneweek: I’m genuinely grateful that my publishers understood my request to leave my family name out and let the book stand on its own merit.#$e#I'd rather step into the light on my own terms, dear.$h
STP.RWE.eventSeen_3912132_memory_fourwee: Dear, do you remember when I told you about C.Sun from the booktour?#$b#They sent me their full draft for beta-reading and I was left thoroughly impressed with their craft!$h#$b#It truly is no wonder they've achieved so much recognition.$h#$e#I should make a note to email them later regarding my feedback.
STP.eventSeen_3912132_memory_oneday: My love, I must admit that going out of town was a whirlwind full of excitement.#$b#Frankly, the whole time I was away, I just could not stop thinking about you – whether you were lonely and alone without me. What if you had fainted in the mines and I wasn’t there?$2#$b#Now that I’m back, I feel elated knowing that I can stay close by you and hold you close.
STP.eventSeen_3912132_memory_oneweek: I met a young writer at the signing who said they found a deep connection with my main protagonist.#$b#At that exact moment, I felt like everything I had poured into the pages of my novel had truly meant something to someone beyond you and the people I hold close to.$1#$e#Apologies for rambling, my love. It just feels so surreal.$1
STP.eventSeen_3912132_memory_twoweeks: My book tour still feels like a fever dream. At the book signing, a reader quoted one of my lines back to me – can you imagine?$1#$b# My work reached someone deeply and found meaning in them. I almost couldn’t believe it!$1
